scenarios.name: Seismic Sense looks at as many cards as you control lands and puts a creature card into your hand
scenarios.ruling: Three lands means X is three, so the top three cards are seen and the only creature card among them can be revealed and taken.

scenarios.name: Seismic Sense can take a land card instead of a creature card
scenarios.ruling: The revealed card may be a creature or a land card; with only a land legal among the top three, that land goes to hand.

scenarios.name: Seismic Sense with one land sees only the top card, so a creature under it is out of reach
scenarios.ruling: X is the number of lands you control. With one land only the top card is looked at, so the Grizzly Bears below it is never seen and stays in the library.
